name: visilant-node-tools
description: The two npm-delivered tools the image needs before the project's own dependencies exist: the package manager, and the Playwright CLI that seeds Chromium. Both are pinned to exactly what the project asks for - pnpm to `packageManager` in package.json, Playwright to what pnpm-lock.yaml resolves - and check-workspace.sh fails the container start if either drifts.
